integrity: All rational identities can be checked with the embedded standard-library CHECK.py. The analytic derivation is supplied independently of the finite tests; no external or independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Four players, three-person expected-payoff groups, two strategies, symmetric independent strategy-flip mutation with 0<mu<1, and independently sampled with-replacement Fermi role model. The derivative assertion is only at neutral selection; exact stronger-selection witnesses are supplied for two profiles. No statement for arbitrary mutation mechanisms, group/population sizes or empirical games.
title: Finite mutation reverses cooperation selection at a fixed full-cooperation return
